div.div: Sparse and Soft MoE layers. While the router in Sparse MoE layers (left) learns to assign individual input tokens to each of the available slots, in Soft MoE layers (right) each slot is the result of a (different) weighted average of all the input tokens. Learning to make discrete assignments introduces several optimization and implementation issues that Soft MoE sidesteps.
